adg_build — DRIVE agv op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.adg_build(paths) (to call the implementation directly, import agvfleet; agvfleet.adg_build(paths); from the registry, opsdrive.get("adg_build"))

Usage

Action dependency graph (Hönig, Kiesel, Tinka, Durham, Ayanian 2019).

Each vehicle's action = "enter the k-th cell of its sequence of cells to visit". There are two kinds of dependency:

(1) the same vehicle's previous action, (2) another vehicle that uses the same cell earlier leaving that cell (in plan time order).

Returns a dict: cells (each vehicle's cell sequence), deps ((i, k) → set of (j, m) that must finish before it). If the plan contains a collision, raises ValueError (the direction of the dependency cannot be determined).
